data.prompt:
Asset: #1 Daniel, #2 Anna, #3 Control Room Survivor, #4 Tunnel Stalker, #5 Underground Network
Prompt VIDEO:
Create a photorealistic live-action cinematic horror sequence inside the abandoned metro control room from Reference #5.
Use References #1 and #2 to preserve Daniel and Anna’s exact identity, facial structure, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing and survival gear, but portray them as realistic human actors.
Use the Control Room Survivor from Reference #3 for the exhausted man locked behind the reinforced side-room door.
The room is dimly illuminated by old surveillance monitors and emergency lights.
A slow metallic scraping sound travels through the ventilation ducts above.
Daniel raises his tactical flashlight.
Anna stands close behind him.
The survivor looks toward the ceiling in fear.
Survivor:
“It found us.”
Daniel turns toward him.
Daniel:
“What found us?”
The scraping suddenly stops directly above Daniel.
Silence.
Anna quietly says:
Anna:
“Daniel…”
A second ventilation grille across the room begins shaking.
The control-room lights flicker once, twice, then shut off.
A heavy impact hits the ventilation system.
Daniel immediately shouts:
Daniel:
“Down!”
A vent panel falls to the floor.
A fast humanoid shadow crosses briefly between the old monitors, inspired by the Tunnel Stalker design from Reference #4, but never reveal it clearly.
Daniel turns his flashlight back on.
Nothing is visible.
Then the rear control-room door slowly begins opening by itself.
End with Daniel and Anna staring toward the opening.
Premium theatrical horror, controlled camera movement, deep shadows, strong sound design, realistic practical lighting, no graphic violence, no visible gore, no text, no watermark.
